title: Schools list and neighbourhood corridors: nothing to test
question: Do the schools list or the Invest in Neighborhoods corridors bear on any grant?
finding: Neither file bears on a grant on its own. The schools list holds 235 schools, 234 active and the rest pending; it has no closed schools to set against program sites. The corridors file maps 25 commercial corridors and was last updated 2016-06-29; it carries no grant or spending.
how: Row counts by status; corridor rows read.
limits: Program sites would need the youth department's site lists; corridor grants are in the workforce office's grant files, not here.

sources.t: DataSF dataset 667d-aah6: Invest in Neighborhood Areas (saved 23 November 2026)
